scope: Main National Palace of Culture congress and arts building at 1 Bulgaria Square, Sofia.

originalReview.notes: Exact 2021 Qualla image, the photographer's original CC0 upload. Shows the plaza side of the palace at dusk with its broad shaded glazing, raised entrance band, pale fascia and repetitive piers. The visible facade lighting is separate from building colors.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact Qualla CC0 original with a current verifiable Commons record and explicit first-upload author dedication. The other catalogued file lacked a retrievable native record and was excluded.
